name: Scene
responsibility: The typed scene: the ordered and positioned list of what a picture is made of, which every painter draws
description: The scene contract: typed data that every painter and the TypeScript bindings read. It computes a traffic mark's pulse train once, so the SVG and GPU painters share one set of numbers and keep only their clocks and their drawing. Its six submodules are private, and each name is reachable through one path. Of the builders it keeps Group::new and Transform::translate; Text::set, the setters and the producer-only constructors belong to Painting, and tests outside Painting build a Text as plain data (ADR 0091). Purpose::Core names the core a double line's mask cuts between its rails, which the SVG painter spells exactly as a cutout and the move recognises by purpose alone.
